topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Rain’s been falling since before the sun came up, and it’s not showing any signs of stopping. Sat in my office, the only light the sickly glow of the streetlamp outside, throwing long shadows over the cracked linoleum. Got a call today, somebody’s best friend’s moving. Other side of the country, they said. Voice on the other end of the line was thick, like the smoke in here. People, they come and they go. It’s the nature of the beast, but that don’t make it any easier when the one you thought was a keeper decides to cast off the anchor. Told them, ain’t no case, but maybe a drink might help. Maybe a long walk in the rain. Sometimes, the world’s just a little too big, and a good friend makes it the right size. Now, they’re on their own, but they’ll find a way. We always do.
